top_issues.issue: Narrow layouts do not adapt: the list pane stays ~232 px, names truncate, the composer placeholder wraps with a dangling '·' and the helper wraps onto 2-3 lines.
top_issues.evidence: 760x640: list x=64-296, content ~430 px; channel-narrow placeholder line 1 ends with '·' at x=655; call-bar helper wraps to 3 lines (y=757-791); calls-narrow 'Katherine ...'.
top_issues.fix: Below 900 pt window width shrink the list to 200 pt (or make it resizable, min 180); below 600 pt content width drop ' · @ to mention' from the placeholder and hide the helper line (show it as a tooltip on a '?' icon). Never wrap placeholders.

top_issues.issue: Call layouts truncate the chat title early and remove all navigation.
top_issues.evidence: call-bar: 'Design review:...' ends at x=178 while the open-in-window icon is at x=335 (~160 px unused). No rail in either call layout.
top_issues.fix: Let the title take all width up to 8 pt before the trailing icon; truncate only on real overflow. Add a back/chats button (24 pt Lucide 'arrow-left' or 'message-circle') at the left of the header so the person can reach other chats.

top_issues.issue: Long drafts are cramped and clipped: tight leading, no top padding, scrollbar beside the attach icon.
top_issues.evidence: Line pitch ~17 px for ~15 pt text (1.13) vs ~24 px in message bodies; first line clipped at y=546-556 by the border; scrollbar thumb at x~1180, y=735-752.
top_issues.fix: Use line height 1.4 (21 pt at 15 pt) in the composer, 10 pt inner top/bottom padding inside the scroll area, put the scrollbar 4 pt inside the composer's right border above the action icons, and cap the composer at 40% of window height.

top_issues.issue: Secondary buttons, reaction chips, hover toolbar and cards rely on borders far below 3:1, so secondary controls barely read as buttons, especially in dark mode.
top_issues.evidence: Border #dfdfe3 on #ffffff = 1.33:1; dark #303137 on #25262b = 1.16:1 (secondary button), on #17181b = 1.37:1. Inputs already use #8a8d95 (3.07-3.32:1) and #6e7179 (3.09-3.64:1).
top_issues.fix: Give secondary buttons and chips a fill: light #eeeef0 with border #b9bbc1, dark #2c2d33 with border #4a4c54; or reuse the input border tokens #8a8d95 / #6e7179 for button outlines so boundaries reach 3:1.

top_issues.issue: Avatar colours and icons in the switcher do not match the chat list, breaking recognition.
top_issues.evidence: Ada: list rgb(69,96,196) blue vs switcher rgb(74,122,46) green; Katherine green vs ochre rgb(143,109,15); Grace teal vs blue rgb(42,115,181); Margaret pink vs green. Meeting chat shows 'D0' initials vs calendar icon in the list.
top_issues.fix: Derive avatar colour from the same key (person id / chat id) everywhere; reuse the list's avatar widget (with presence dot) and the calendar icon for meeting chats in the switcher.

top_issues.issue: At 1920 wide the message column caps at ~920 px but the composer and header span the full 1540 px, so the composer does not line up with the text.
top_issues.evidence: Messages x=380-1300; composer x=380-1904; ~600 px dead area right of messages.
top_issues.fix: Cap the composer (and hover toolbar anchor) to the same max width as the message column (about 920 pt), or let messages use the full width up to ~1100 pt and centre the column with the composer.

top_issues.issue: Pasted image thumbnails are crudely centre-cropped and their remove buttons overlap the image.
top_issues.evidence: Third thumbnail (x=698-840) shows only fragments; x buttons at (522,632),(675,632),(826,632) sit on the image corners; no name or size.
top_issues.fix: Use aspect-fit thumbnails at 96 pt height on a #eeeef0 / #2c2d33 plate, place the 20 pt remove button 4 pt outside the top-right corner with a 1 pt ring, and show name + size (11-12 pt) below like the file chip.

top_issues.issue: The hover toolbar straddles neighbouring rows and card borders.
top_issues.evidence: group-chat toolbar y=389-425 over the mention row ending at y~399; channel toolbar y=250-287 crosses the card border at y=261.
top_issues.fix: Anchor the toolbar inside the hovered row: top = row top + 4 pt, right = row right - 8 pt; for channel posts place it inside the card's top-right corner.

top_issues.issue: Control sizing and glyphs are inconsistent: Join button and link field differ in height, text-triangle disclosures and ▼ dropdown carets instead of Lucide icons.
top_issues.evidence: Join field 29 px vs button 32 px, baselines offset ~2 px; '▸ Details', '▸ App registration'; settings dropdowns use a solid ▼.
top_issues.fix: Make field and button share one height (32 pt) and baseline; replace ▸ with Lucide chevron-right (rotating to chevron-down) and ▼ with Lucide chevron-down at 16 pt in the secondary text colour.

top_issues.issue: Meeting detail is thin and partly redundant while most of the pane is empty.
top_issues.evidence: Card 640x210 at top-left; 'Location: Teams' duplicates 'Online: Microsoft Teams meeting'; no attendees or response.
top_issues.fix: Drop the Location row when it equals the online provider, add attendees (avatars + count) and your response, and widen the card to the pane width minus 24 pt margins (max 720 pt); move the footnote into the card as 13 pt secondary text.

top_issues.evidence: 'Be right back' and 'Appear away' both show the same yellow ring (#a9530f-ish ring with dot); 'Busy' and 'Do not disturb' both solid red.
top_issues.fix: Use Teams-style distinct glyphs: Away = yellow clock, Be right back = yellow clock with arrow, Busy = red filled dot, DND = red dot with white bar; add 11 pt section labels 'Accounts', 'Status'.

top_issues.issue: The error toast is placed at the top-left of the conversation, covering messages, away from the failed message.
top_issues.evidence: Toast at x=393-886, y=64-111 over the first visible message; failed message at y=627-697.
top_issues.fix: Show toasts bottom-centre above the composer (12 pt gap) or top-centre of the pane; tint the failed message row with the danger tint (#fdecec light / #3a2022 dark) and keep the inline Retry.

top_issues.issue: Dialogs are inconsistent: some lack a close button, and a disabled primary button looks like a secondary one.
top_issues.evidence: Settings, New chat, Shortcuts, Join on phone have an x; Status message and permission dialog do not. Disabled Save is #62656d on #e4e4e8, same family as Cancel.
top_issues.fix: Add the 24 pt close icon to every dialog header; render disabled primary as the accent at 40% opacity (light #a9530f66 fill, white text) so its role is still clear.

top_issues.issue: Loading and empty states leave live controls that do nothing and duplicate messages.
top_issues.evidence: Loading: spinner at x=231 next to an active refresh button; filter enabled. Empty: 'No chats yet' in the list plus 'Start your first chat' in the pane.
top_issues.fix: Replace the refresh icon with the spinner while syncing; disable/hide the filter until there is at least one chat; remove the list's 'No chats yet' when the main pane shows the empty state.

top_issues.issue: Image preview is a modal with weak controls and no actions.
top_issues.evidence: 960x745 modal; unselected '100%' segment has no boundary; title 'Image preview' with no name; no Save/Copy/Open.
top_issues.fix: Use a full-window overlay with 24 pt margins, a segmented control with a 1 pt #8a8d95 / #6e7179 outline, the file name as the title, and Save, Copy and Open-in-viewer icon buttons beside the close button.

top_issues.issue: Hyphens render with a visible gap, so words look split.
top_issues.evidence: 'On -call', 'full -text', 'go/no -go', 'Sign -in', 'Step -by -step', 'F4KQ - 9TZW' in every screen with hyphenated words.
top_issues.fix: Use U+002D (or make sure the bundled Inter includes U+2010/U+2011 and is used for them) so the hyphen gets normal sidebearings; check the fallback font chain.

top_issues.issue: Setup page shows a stray scrollbar and styles its guide link unlike other links.
top_issues.evidence: Scrollbar at x=1275 y=0-790; footer at y=777; guide link is bold #1b1c1f text with a blue icon while chat links are #1f63c6 underlined.
top_issues.fix: Reduce top padding (logo at y~60) so the page fits at 800 pt without scrolling; style the guide link with the link colour #1f63c6 / #7cb4f5 and underline on hover.
